# Kinocut

> Kinocut is a subscription edit bay. It edits YouTube videos, shorts, podcast clips, and ads for one flat monthly fee, one request at a time. Cancel anytime.

## Offer

- One flat monthly fee. Launch price is $4,500 per month.
- One active request at a time, then the next one starts.
- About 48 hours average turnaround once the handoff is complete.
- Unlimited revisions on the open cut.
- Up to 2 users, a shared request board, captions, commercial music, and stock footage.
- Cancel before the next bill. The month already paid stays usable until it ends.
- Pricing: https://kinocut.studio/#pricing

## How it works

1. Subscribe. Pick the bay. One queue, no hourly meter. Cancel before the next bill.
2. Send footage. A Google Drive, Dropbox, Frame.io, or WeTransfer link is enough, plus one sentence about what the video must do.
3. Receive edits. A finished cut comes back, usually within 48 hours, with captions, grade, and sound cleaned up.

How it works: https://kinocut.studio/#how

## Who it is for

YouTubers, podcasters, agencies, startups, course creators, and social media teams who publish every week.

## What is not included

Kinocut does not shoot. It does not build 3D scenes, feature-length films, or heavy VFX such as set extensions, creature work, or frame-by-frame cleanup.
